title: Algebra sheaves of tensor powers and their homogeneous quotient
statement: For a closed immersion j:Z→X [def-weil-closed-immersion] and an invertible O_X-module L [def-sc-invertible-module], there exist commutative O_X-algebra sheaves B,C [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], an algebra map p:B→C, homogeneous maps b_d:L^d→B and c_d:j_*j^*L^d→C, exhibiting their underlying module sheaves as coproducts. They satisfy b_d;p=eta_d;c_d for the chosen tensor-pullback unit [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and b_a(s)b_d(t)=b_(a+d)(tensorPowAddIso(a,d)^(-1)(s⊗t)) on every open. No kernel or degree projection data and no square-zero assumption are included.

source.place: Tag 09MS, coherent-equation-ses and its direct sum; canonical construction before cohomology

proof.text: Apply lem-sc-tensor-power-algebra-coproduct to construct B,b, their coproduct universal property and homogeneous multiplication identity. This only constructs the algebra on X.

Use the chosen adjunction a=Classical.choose(exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j). Apply lem-sc-algebra-tensor-pullback-comparison to B to obtain C,p,e with U(p)=eta_B;e.hom. Define c_d=F(b_d);e.hom. Unit naturality proves b_d;U(p)=eta_(L^d);c_d for this precise chosen unit.

Prove coproduct preservation of F=j_*j^* directly, using lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-unit-quotient. For a cofan s from F(L^d), compose its inclusions with eta_d and descend along the coproduct b to g:B→s.pt. The tensor-hom adjunction makes J tensor - preserve coproducts. Naturality of multiplication by J and its vanishing after each eta_d show J B→B→s.pt is zero. Cancel the epi factor to its image, descend g through the cokernel, and use the unit-quotient isomorphism to get F(B)→s.pt. The epi units and the universal property of b give factorization and uniqueness. Transport this colimit along e and combine all fields of TensorGradedAlgebraData. This is the fully proved private helper restrictionCofanIsColimit, not a new sorry.
